projects.name: SkillMap

projects.description: A peer-learning and skill analytics platform that helps technical learners understand their strengths, identify skill gaps, and connect with peers on similar learning journeys. The backend ingests resume PDFs and LeetCode profiles, structures them using LLMs, embeds them semantically in a vector database, and enables intelligent skill-gap analysis and peer matching.
highlights: End-to-end backend design and implementation including REST APIs, data modeling, and secure authentication.
LLM-powered resume parsing with retry logic, moderation checks, and fallback model handling.
Custom skill taxonomy covering 50+ technical skills across DSA, Web Development, Databases, AI/ML, DevOps, and Software Engineering.
Dual skill profiling combining structured resume data with LeetCode competitive programming statistics.
Semantic search and peer matching using vector embeddings stored in Qdrant.
Automated skill-gap analysis with AI-generated personalized learning paths.
LeetCode integration with category-wise problem-solving insights segmented by difficulty.
Production-ready system with authentication, rate limiting, robust file handling, comprehensive error handling, logging, and Docker-based deployment.

projects.name: Intellidine
projects.subtitle: Microservices-Based Restaurant Management Platform
projects.description: A multi-tenant SaaS platform for restaurants that digitizes ordering, payments, and in-restaurant operations. Customers scan table-specific QR codes to browse menus, place orders, and pay. Staff interfaces support order management, kitchen operations, and inventory tracking. Built using a microservices architecture with tenant isolation, event-driven communication, and scalable infrastructure.
highlights: Multi-tenant architecture with strict tenant isolation enforced via tenant_id at both JWT and database layers.
Eight-service microservices architecture: auth, menu, order, payment, inventory, notification, analytics, and discount-engine.
Event-driven communication between services using Kafka for reliable, scalable message flows.
JWT authentication with role-based access (MANAGER, WAITER, KITCHEN_STAFF, SUPER_ADMIN) and OTP-based customer login.
WebSocket support powering real-time order updates and Kitchen Display System (KDS) notifications.
Razorpay integration with webhook verification and fallback handlers for cash-based workflows.
Redis caching with automatic invalidation for menu, category, and frequently updated entities.
Twelve Jest test suites covering critical business workflows across independent services.
Production-grade observability using Prometheus metrics and Grafana dashboards.
Dual deployment support: local development via Docker Compose and production via Nginx reverse proxy.
